query: SELECT table_name FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND (table_name ILIKE '%claim%' OR table_name ILIKE '%case%' OR table_name ILIKE '%refund%' OR table_name ILIKE '%return%' OR table_name ILIKE '%activity%' OR table_name ILIKE '%audit%') ORDER BY table_name LIMIT 50;
